title: Frigid Manipulations
subtitle: Congeatio — blood remembers cold
text: The Frigid tendency belongs to blood that has congealed — not from death, but from exposure to deep cold. Glacial Grasp (QUICK, 125): crystallize blood around a target's extremities, slowing and rooting them briefly. Cryogenic Pulse (QUICK, 150): burst outward in a radius of congealing blood-frost, slowing everything nearby. Glacial Bastion (QUICK, 350): harden your blood into a temporary barrier of crystallized ice-blood directly in front of you. The Frigid practitioner is a defensive one. Cold blood does not rush.
